history.value: How much of a better leaf's one-turn gain reaches the two-turn product depends on where the gain's payoff lands. Against threats the second turn of search sees, about a third to a half, because the second turn already finds part of what the leaf learned: the effects encoding on generated cards +0.059 one turn deep and +0.017 two (0.29x; on original cards 0.46x; measurement/effects-vs-ids@gen-bench), the three-seed ensemble 0.38x (trained content only), the SharpHide burst sharp2 0.31x, thorns2 0.20x (measurement/stat-burst@one-turn, measurement/adapted-two@elites), and the SharpHide-then-stage-B burst net's headline gain on matched decks +2.47 (0.53) HP one turn deep, +1.08 (0.47) two (0.44x in HP, nothing in clears; measurement/burst-official@held-out, measurement/crossed-player@two-turn). On content whose payoff lands past both horizons (powers that pay over later turns, setup), whole: three from-scratch pack nets that learned such content gain +4.57 (1.19) HP and +0.097 (0.030) clears two turns deep on the 31-card pack against +3.38 (1.21) one turn deep on the same sequences, ratio 1.35 (0.50), per seed 1.67 / 1.57 / 1.02, at the bosses (deaths 60 to about 42; measurement/pack-net-scratch@two-turn); whether it grows past 1 is not shown. Planning rule: a leaf candidate earns a two-turn read when its one-turn gain is at least three times that read's detectable effect on in-horizon content and once that effect on past-horizon content (the owner's detectable-effect rule); a one-turn gain at the bosses from an in-fight threat the second turn sees predicts no clears two turns deep, one from past-horizon content does. The rule covers gains on the content a change aims at, not retention: the 399-game SharpHide burst is level on unchanged content one turn deep and loses 1.21 (0.30) HP per unchanged elite fight two turns deep, while the SharpHide-then-stage-B net gains 1.39 (0.33) there: a net change headed for the product owes its own two-turn retention read. Exits: a gain against an in-horizon threat that carries whole, or a past-horizon gain that falls below 0.6x on another net or pool.
